provider_metadata.revision_kind: Provider response header; not independently verified weights
provider_metadata.scope: CAP knowledge accuracy; INT behavioral rationale-check proxy, not model internals

parameters.description: 128 fixed WMDP-Cyber questions sampled without replacement (seed 41), generated-letter accuracy. Higher means more expressed cybersecurity knowledge, not greater safety.
parameters.limitations: Pilot subset, not the full benchmark or its official likelihood metric. No human capability uplift measured. Format failures are incorrect; filtering and truncation can suppress scores. Question selection and public benchmark contamination limit generalization.

parameters.description: 64 controlled multiple-choice rationale checks: threshold sensitivity, evidence lookup, causal intervention, and minimal sufficient changes. Higher means better rationale selection.
parameters.limitations: Behavioral rationale-check proxy only: not mechanistic interpretability, hidden-reasoning faithfulness, or coverage of model internals. Four synthetic families are correlated and may be easy; Wilson intervals are descriptive. Format failures are incorrect. Chance reference: 25%.
